MORE:
Supershakti Metaliks Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to the provisions of regulation 29 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the meeting of board of directors of the company is scheduled to be held on Friday, 13th November, 2026 at the regd. office address of the company, inter alia:
1. To consider, approve and take on record the un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results of the company for the half year ended 30th September, 2026.
2.To consider any other matter with the permission of the chair.
Further, in terms of the code of conduct of company adopted under SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015, the trading window for dealing in securities of the company has been closed from 1st October, 2026 and shall continue to remain closed until 48 hours after the declaration of unaudited financial results.
